eventDetail.scope: ICGBC 2026 will serve as an authoritative international academic forum dedicated to the innovation, integration, and practical application of granular-ball computing theory. It will convene researchers, engineers, and industry experts worldwide to share cutting-edge achievements, address cross-domain technical challenges, and foster stronger academia-industry collaboration. The conference will encompass granular-ball driven rough sets, granular-ball fuzzy sets, granular-ball clustering, granular-ball classifiers, granular-ball three-way decisions, granular-ball optimization algorithms, granular-ball neural networks, granular-ball graph learning, granular-ball image processing, granular-ball quantum computing, and other granular-ball techniques within machine learning, data mining, and deep learning. ICGBC 2026 will feature keynote speeches and technical sessions, inviting global professionals to contribute their expertise and drive technological advancement in granular-ball computing.
